StateTransitionPattern.detection_rule: AssignmentNode where target name contains any of (_step, Step, State, Sequence, ToolChangeState, LightState, StartupStep, BatchStep)
StateTransitionPattern.trigger_condition: Simple substring match on target variable name

CounterUpdatePattern.detection_rule: AssignmentNode where target contains counter substrings (CTU, CTD, CTUD, Counter, _Cnt, _Count, cnt, T1_Cnt, T2_Cnt) OR self-increment/decrement BinaryExpressionNode (+/-) with target appearing in RHS sources
CounterUpdatePattern.trigger_condition: Name substring OR generic self-increment AST structure
CounterUpdatePattern.ast_evidence: AssignmentNode + BinaryExpressionNode operator and operand presence

HistoryUpdatePattern.detection_rule: AssignmentNode where target contains any of (last, previous, old, _last, history, x_last, y_last, tl)

false_positive: t_last := tx (where tx is current time, not previous)
last := tx (in timer reset context, not history update)

AccumulatorPattern.detection_rule: AssignmentNode where value is BinaryExpressionNode with operator in XOR/OR/AND and target in RHS, OR operator in +/-/*/ and target in RHS

true_positive: i := IN + in_last * 5.0E-7 * KI * tc + i (PID integral)

ArrayAccessPattern.detection_rule: AssignmentNode where value is ArrayIndexNode OR target is ArrayIndexNode
ArrayAccessPattern.ast_evidence: ArrayIndexNode in target or value position

false_positive: temp := PT[pos] (array access in CRC, not array pattern in industrial sense)

MatrixAccessPattern.detection_rule: AssignmentNode where value is FunctionInvocationNode with MATRIX_MUL/ADD/INV/TRANSPOSE OR target contains Matrix/matrix/mat/_M/_A/_B/_C/Result and value contains [ or mat/Matrix/M/A/B/C
MatrixAccessPattern.trigger_condition: Function name match OR extremely weak substring heuristic on target and value
MatrixAccessPattern.ast_evidence: FunctionInvocationNode name OR generic AssignmentNode with substring match

false_positive: BIT_LOAD_B := in AND NOT SHL(...) (target BIT_LOAD_B contains _B, value contains A from AND)
L_temp := BIT_LOAD_B(...) (target contains _C? No, L_temp contains no _C. Wait, L_temp contains no _C. Hmm, maybe from _C in _CRC_GEN?)

BitwiseUpdatePattern.detection_rule: AssignmentNode where value is FunctionInvocationNode with SHL/SHR/ROL/ROR/AND/OR/XOR/NOT/BIT_LOAD_B/BIT_OF_DWORD OR value is BinaryExpressionNode with AND/OR/XOR
BitwiseUpdatePattern.trigger_condition: Function name match OR operator match

RateCalculationPattern.detection_rule: AssignmentNode where value is BinaryExpressionNode with operator / and target contains Flow/flow/Rate/rate/Speed/speed/Freq/freq OR sources contain delta/time/dt/period/pulse/count
RateCalculationPattern.trigger_condition: Name substring on target OR sources

examples.missed: F := (UDINT_TO_REAL(Y - y_last) + X - x_last) / TIME_TO_REAL(tx - tl) * 3.6E6 (target F does not contain Rate/Flow, sources do not contain delta/time/dt/period/pulse/count)

ProcessCalculationPattern.detection_rule: AssignmentNode where value is FunctionInvocationNode with SQRT/ABS/EXP/LN/SIN/COS/TAN/MODR/FLOOR/SIGN_R/LAMBERT_W OR value is BinaryExpressionNode with +/-/*/MOD and target contains PID/FT_/Control/Output/Process
ProcessCalculationPattern.trigger_condition: Function name match OR naming heuristic on target
ProcessCalculationPattern.ast_evidence: FunctionInvocationNode name OR BinaryExpressionNode operator + target substring

false_positive: F := ... / ... (target F does not match ProcessCalculation, but FLOOR does)
MODR := in - DINT_TO_REAL(FLOOR2(in / divi)) * divi (target MODR is function name, not process output)

FunctionBlockInvocationPattern.detection_rule: FunctionBlockCallNode where fb_name starts with TON/TOF/TP or contains TIMER or starts with CTU/CTD/CTUD or contains COUNTER or starts with PID/FT_

true_positive: int1(_E := ..., X := VX, Y := X) → fb_invocation
false_positive: Timer(IN:=TRUE, PT:= T#0s) in test scaffolding

StateTransitionPattern.fp_source: TestState test scaffolding variables dominate test harness (194 of 242 test harness detections)

CounterUpdatePattern.fp_source: floor/FLOOR2 math functions (50+), TestState self-increment (80+), T_PLC_US/T_PLC_MS timer updates (80+), totalTests/passedTests test counters (150+), loop iterators (pos, bits, i) (60+)

HistoryUpdatePattern.fp_source: last := tx in timer reset contexts (where tx is current time, not previous state), t_last := tx in test harness

AccumulatorPattern.fp_source: floor/FLOOR2 (50+), TestState (80+), T_PLC_US/T_PLC_MS timer updates (100+), totalTests/passedTests (150+), generic self-increment in loops (100+)

MatrixAccessPattern.fp_source: Catastrophic substring bug: _B matches BIT_LOAD_B, _C matches _CRC_GEN, _M matches any variable with M, A matches AND, B matches BYTE, C matches CRC, Result matches any target. Zero real matrix operations detected.

BitwiseUpdatePattern.fp_source: AND/OR/XOR in boolean expressions that are not bitwise (e.g., _CRC_GEN := ... OR ... in CRC accumulator, which is bitwise but the pattern mislabels it as generic bitwise)

RateCalculationPattern.fp_source: Dead pattern. Heuristic target names (Flow, Rate, Speed, Freq) and source names (delta, time, dt, period, pulse, count) do not match actual industrial rate calculations (e.g., FLOW_METER uses F as target and tx/tl as time sources).

ProcessCalculationPattern.fp_source: MODR := ... (MODR is a function return variable, not a process output), FLOOR := REAL_TO_INT(X) (function return variable)

FunctionBlockInvocationPattern.fp_source: Test scaffolding blocks: TestBlock, Test_0-Test_8, Timer (test timers) account for ~95% of detections

overlap_analysis.CounterUpdatePattern ↔ AccumulatorPatter: Severe overlap on self-increment arithmetic. Both match floor-1, TestState+1, T_PLC_US+OFFSET, totalTests+1. CounterUpdatePattern should match ONLY explicit counters, AccumulatorPattern should match ONLY accumulators.
overlap_analysis.StateTransitionPattern ↔ CounterUpdatePa: TestState+1 matches both StateTransitionPattern (target name contains State) and CounterUpdatePattern (self-increment). Triple overlap with AccumulatorPattern.
overlap_analysis.FunctionBlockInvocationPattern ↔ Operati: 100% overlap. FunctionBlockCallNode is already visited by OperationExtractor.
